reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: Schedule persistent reminders in a channel or by DM.
reminders.invalidDuration: ❌ Invalid duration. Enter a number of minutes (minimum 1 minute, maximum {days} day(s)).
reminders.dmDisabled: ❌ DM reminders are disabled on this server.

allowDm.label: Allow reminders by direct message
allowDm.help: Lets a member be reminded by direct message rather than in the channel. Discord refuses DMs from members who have closed them: the reminder then falls back to the original channel rather than being lost.

maxDelayDays.label: Maximum delay for a reminder (days)
maxDelayDays.help: The furthest ahead a reminder can be set. It guards storage as much as common sense: each reminder holds a database row until it fires, and one set ten years out will not be read by the same person.

targetId.label: Member / role id
targetId.help: Discord snowflake of the person or role to notify.

channelId.label: Reminder channel
channelId.help: Leave empty to send a direct message (“member” recipient only).

champs.delayMinutes: In how many minutes? (“once only” cadence)

msg.roleNeedsChannel: A role reminder must target a channel.
msg.delayOutOfRange: Delay out of range (1 to {max} minutes).
msg.dmDisabled: Reminders by direct message are disabled.
